purpose: Arithmetic consistency check of saved engineering baseline evidence; not an independent validation experiment
limitations: No model execution or new training performed; saved probabilities and losses are the evidence inputs.
Source sessions, persons and original-video independence are unconfirmed. This script does not establish a trustworthy split.
Exactly one engineering-validation sample per class; metrics do not establish generalization or paper reproduction.
Ten loss points from one epoch do not establish convergence, overfitting success or a multi-epoch trend.
Class strings are reproduced as recorded, not adjudicated semantic ground truth; label 0 is named anya_mopping while clip paths use an_mopping.

assertions.assertion: Both saved runs report PASS
Exactly ten recorded iterations, numbered 1 through 10
All ten recorded training losses are finite
Saved run contains one training epoch
Each saved total loss equals the saved classification loss
Training and evaluation record the same configuration hash
Training and evaluation record the same checkpoint hash
Saved evaluation contains ten clips and ten probabilities per clip
All saved probabilities are finite
All saved probabilities are within [0, 1]
Probability row sums equal one within absolute tolerance 1e-6
Engineering validation contains exactly one sample for every class
Saved evaluation contains ten distinct clip path strings
Saved true class strings agree with the saved integer-to-class map
Saved clip labels and frame counts agree with the evaluation annotation summary
Training and reloaded evaluation use the same saved validation summary
No equal probability values within a clip; top-k tie policy does not affect this result
Probability argmax agrees with every saved predicted label
Saved predicted class strings agree with the saved integer-to-class map
Count confusion matrix totals ten samples
Recomputed count confusion matrix equals the saved matrix
Recomputed acc/top1 agrees with train result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Recomputed acc/top1 agrees with evaluate result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Recomputed acc/top5 agrees with train result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Recomputed acc/top5 agrees with evaluate result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Recomputed acc/mean1 agrees with train result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Recomputed acc/mean1 agrees with evaluate result within absolute tolerance 1e-12
Both input result JSON files remain byte-for-byte unchanged
